scene: The brass automaton clicks open its chest hatch to reveal whirring gears.
picture: First-person close-up filling the frame with the automaton's open brass chest cavity. At centre is an unlit coin slot above ticking clockwork gears. On the left sits a shut blue valve wheel. On the right, a weathered folded parchment map is wedged between two slowly turning brass cogs.
shown: a slender coin slot glowing faintly on the chest panel at centre
a small painted pressure valve turned shut on the left side
a curled harbour map tucked behind brass cogs on the right
